title: 1815 Prairie's mansard roof sits low behind its iron cresting
items: The flat top of 1815 Prairie's mansard had been built far steeper than intended, so it rose dark above the iron cresting. It now drops out of sight behind the rail, and the cresting stands against the sky as both old photographs show it.
The Keith house at 1808 Prairie had the same fault in its 1886 form. Its hidden roof now falls at the intended angle, which shows a little more sky through its pierced parapet.
